Tesseract.js 5.1.1 (Apache-2.0, see LICENSE) — vendored for the vigilancia "Lector de placas" module.
Downloaded once from jsDelivr; served from Firebase Hosting so OCR runs without third-party requests.
The files are immutable per version: to upgrade, put them in a new versioned path or bump the ?v= of
lector-placas.js, since /vendor/** is served with a 1-year immutable Cache-Control.

LICENSE                                https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tesseract.js@5.1.1/LICENSE.md

core/tesseract-core-lstm.wasm.js       https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tesseract.js-core@5.1.1/tesseract-core-lstm.wasm.js
